bugs.title: 30% of the backtest had no P&L
bugs.detail: Rebalance dates came from resample("ME"), which returns calendar month-ends. When the 31st fell on a weekend the date was absent from the price index, the cross-section came back empty, and the loop skipped the month before accruing its returns.
bugs.evidence: 55 of 180 month-ends were not trading days; 578 of 1,971 out-of-sample days were missing entirely.

bugs.title: CAGR annualised on a series with holes
bugs.detail: Growth was annualised by 252/len(returns), which is only correct if the series covers every trading day. It did not.
bugs.evidence: The reported 5.9% CAGR was 4.1% over the elapsed window.

bugs.title: Every momentum horizon wrong by 1.45x
bugs.detail: The lag helper subtracted calendar days and treated them as trading days.
bugs.evidence: “12–1 momentum” measured 173 trading days — 8.2 months. 6–1 measured 4.1 months; the 5-day reversal measured 3.

bugs.title: The label was 28% market
bugs.detail: An L2 loss on raw forward returns spends its budget on the common date move, which is identical across names and cannot change a cross-sectional ranking.
bugs.evidence: 28.1% of the label's variance is the date mean. The file was named gbm_ranker.py and had no ranking objective.

bugs.title: The top feature was a size dummy
bugs.detail: “liquidity” was log dollar volume — a level, not a signal.
bugs.evidence: Monthly cross-sectional rank autocorrelation 0.96. Most model splits of any feature, and the most negative IC in the book: −0.0275, IR −0.274.

bugs.title: No factor carried information
bugs.detail: Three of the ten factors were the same volatility measure, and quality_proxy was a 252-day Sharpe ratio.
bugs.evidence: Every factor's IC information ratio fell between −0.27 and +0.09.
